title: Special-fibre smoothness components of the prepared Popescu quotient
statement: Let R be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], pi in R with Ann_R(pi)=Ann_R(pi^2), and Cbar an R/pi^2R-algebra compatible with its R-algebra structure. Let d be prepared finite polynomial data as in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]. Define Q=R[x,z], p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}, J=(f_l-pi z_l,p_{kl}), and D=ULift(Q/J). Let c:Cbar to D/pi D be an R-algebra map taking epsilon(X_i) to the class of the original generator x_i. Let cmod:Cbar/pi Cbar to D/pi D have composite with the quotient projection equal to c. For every prime q of D/pi D whose inverse image under c is smooth over R/pi^2R [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal], R to D is smooth at the inverse-image prime of D, and Cbar/pi Cbar to D/pi D is smooth at q for the algebra structure induced by cmod. This concerns only the explicit constructed D, not arbitrary algebras.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP), chart quotients D_k and properties (c), (d).

proof.text: For each prime q of D/pi D whose pullback to Cbar is smooth, apply the finite cover in Prepared.cover to choose k with epsilon(reduced(a_k)) outside that pullback. By definition of prime contraction this is c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) outside q.

proof.text: Apply the chart-fibres theorem to obtain smoothness of the residue-field fibre of R to D at the fibre prime corresponding to qD, and smoothness of (D/pi D) localized at c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) over Cbar/pi Cbar with exactly the cmod algebra structure.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Apply the chart-flat theorem to obtain flatness of the canonical localRingHom R_p to D_qD. The already proved PopescuLiftPresentation.finitePresentation gives finite presentation of D over R. Choose g=1 for the local finite-presentation hypothesis: one avoids every prime, and FinitePresentation.of_isLocalizationAway supplies finite presentation of D_1. Apply the existing flat-smooth-fibre criterion to conclude IsSmoothAtPrime R qD.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: For the relative special-fibre conclusion, choose c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) itself as the smooth neighbourhood element. It avoids q, and its localization is smooth by the second output of the chart-fibres theorem. This is precisely IsSmoothAtPrime for cmod.toAlgebra. Combine the two pointwise implications using forall_and and imp_and.

theorem popescu_lift_smooth_special (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] [IsNoetherianRing R] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (hAnnR : Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) =
      Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)))
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom) :
    (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)),
      IsSmoothAtPrime (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap c.toRingHom q) →
      IsSmoothAtPrime R (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) q)) ∧
    (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)),
      IsSmoothAtPrime (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap c.toRingHom q) →
      @IsSmoothAtPrime (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar))
        (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
          Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra))
        _ _ cmod.toAlgebra q)
